Revision of pay of employees stagnating at the maximum of the Pay Band and Grade Pay or scale in pre-revised structure.In case of persons who had been drawing maximum of the applicable Pay Band and Grade Pay or scale for more than two years as on 1-1-2016, one increment in the applicable Level in the Pay Matrix shall be granted on 1-1-2016 for every two completed years of stagnation at the maximum of the said Pay Band and Grade Pay or scale.
